name: National Archives founding documents

notes: The site's Copyright, Restrictions, and Permissions Notice (in its privacy and legal notices page) says NARA-produced works are public domain and available under CC0 1.0, but also that not all material on the site is public domain, that donor-restricted items and images from other organizations occur, and that NARA cannot confirm the status of any item and that use is at the user's own risk. The founding-docs pages themselves state no licence, and the text there was not confirmed item by item, so the source is not bounded cleanly enough to show. Link to the pages; check the transcript's page before storing any.
